question: Does Cirrascale still sell H100 and A100 80GB? Its own pricing page on 2026-11-06 lists GB300, B300, B200, RTX PRO 6000, MI355X, MI350 and Qualcomm AI 100 Ultra only, while gpuperhour lists H100 SXM5 at USD 2.49 and A100 PCIe 80GB at USD 2.60 per GPU-hour.
why: The record's H100 and A100 rates rest on a third-party aggregator; the vendor page no longer carries them and says it does not list everything it sells, so the two sources cannot be reconciled from the pages read.
